actions.title: Add generated-helper runtime validation guardrail
actions.desired_outcome: Prevent generated Python helpers from being delivered when an exercised runtime path contains an unresolved name, missing import, or untested reporting failure.
acceptance_criteria: A repository-owned validator runs py_compile and a declared runtime self-test for each generated helper.
A negative fixture with an unimported hashlib reference fails before helper delivery.
Helper delivery records the validator result and helper digest before user invocation.
measurement_plan: Track missing-import or unresolved-name recurrence across the next five generated helper deliveries.
Record runtime-self-test pass or failure in the associated SAGE session or evidence package.
Do not mark the action measured or closed until the recurrence rate is evaluated.

history.reason: Register the generated-helper runtime-validation control identified by the SAGE metrics pilot post-session review

actions.title: Enforce failure-triggered SAGE retrieval before retry
actions.desired_outcome: Every repository validator failure consults prior evidence, lessons, actionable failures, and canonical recovery before another corrective attempt, with a local receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Every nonzero validator result retrieves before retry guidance.
The gate writes source counts and ranked results to a receipt.
Tests load every production dotted-key failure record.
A second same-class failure requires a lesson or action.
measurement_plan: Measure receipts across the next ten validator failures.
Track attempts made before the first retrieval receipt.
Track recurrence and avoidable rework after activation.

history.reason: Register the preventive control required by SAGE-LESSON-20260801-001.

actions.title: Derive SAGE bootstrap recovery from repository authority
actions.desired_outcome: A new SAGE context is bootstrapped by reading an existing authority context and using its exact match term, rather than guessing another natural-language request that may also be unclassified.
acceptance_criteria: Bootstrap recovery selects an existing context that owns sage-change-authority.json.
The recovery preflight uses an exact match_terms value from that context.
A repeated same-class discovery failure is recorded before another retry.
The original literal request is retried only after the new context passes the discovery guardrail.
The helper self-test exercises authority-derived request selection.
measurement_plan: Inspect the next ten new-context bootstrap attempts.
Count guessed bootstrap requests and require the value to remain zero.
Track repeated UNCLASSIFIED recovery failures and avoidable retries.

history.reason: Register the preventive action required by a repeated discovery-bootstrap failure.
The classifier diagnostic proved that exact match_terms values are insufficient for repository-governance discovery.

actions.title: Validate SAGE bootstrap recovery through the actual classifier
actions.desired_outcome: A new SAGE context is bootstrapped by evaluating authority-owned candidate requests through the actual classifier and using a proven successful request, rather than assuming match_terms, context IDs, or filenames are classification contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The failed exact-match-term action is rejected with diagnostic evidence.
Bootstrap recovery consumes a complete read-only classifier diagnostic.
The selected request comes from an authority-owned path and passes both direct and Make classification.
The original literal request is retried only after the new context passes the discovery guardrail.
The helper self-test rejects a match-term-only diagnostic and accepts a classifier-proven authoritative path.
measurement_plan: Inspect the next ten new-context bootstrap attempts.
Count untested bootstrap requests and require the value to remain zero.
Track repeated UNCLASSIFIED recovery failures and avoidable retries.

history.reason: Register the classifier-validated replacement for the rejected recovery action.

actions.title: Enforce file-based Kalaxy3 execution delivery
actions.desired_outcome: Every multi-step or mutating Kalaxy3 operator workflow is delivered as a validated downloadable executable helper with a SHA-256 checksum and one short invocation, unless the operator explicitly requests console commands.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md defines file-based execution delivery as the Kalaxy3 default.
A repository guardrail validates the delivery contract, lesson recurrence, action linkage, authority registration, and root Make integration.
The root SAGE self-test executes the file-delivery guardrail.
No unsolicited multi-command console block is used in the next ten Kalaxy3 execution workflows.
measurement_plan: Inspect the next ten Kalaxy3 execution workflows for delivery format.
Count unsolicited multi-command console blocks and require the value to remain zero.
Track whether each generated helper records a runtime self-test result, SHA-256 digest, and one-line invocation.

history.reason: Register the guardrail required after the known file-delivery lesson recurred.
The operator confirmed the repeated file-delivery failure and required repository enforcement.
The file-based execution delivery contract and guardrail are implemented. The recovery request now classifies through the repository-owned continuous-improvement mapping.
